description: Looks up what a custom program error code means for a given program, using 1,800+ named errors from major Solana programs plus the runtime's own errors. Use it when you only have a code such as 6001 or 0x1771 from a simulation or an RPC response.

code.description: Error code as a number, or a hex string like 0x1771.

programId.description: Base58 address of the program that raised the error.

name: explain_error
title: Explain a Solana program error code
